next_step_summary: PR #257 adds a bounded local Gemini provider-experiment harness for 10 synthetic/sanitized security cases. It keeps expected oracle answers out of prompts, scores semantic values, mechanism identity, answer-state axes, evidence refs and candidate resolution, rejects unsupported refs and guessed unavailable values, reads the API key only from the local environment/Desktop .env.local, and provides a Windows double-click launcher. The actual provider run is not claimed by the PR; the next step is the owner's local run and review of the generated JSON before any further LLM↔Python schema change.
